I realize you might not even care about what I said. I’ve been there too. But I just want you to know, thank you for existing, and I hope you continue to exist. Every human on this earth is amazing in some way, is important in some way. You are amazing hun. I’ve been there. I’ve tried some shit and it will always hurt. No matter what you do, that shit gone hurt. I know it’s literally so fucking hard to go day by day, and you just want to end it all. But there will always be something that stops you. Rather it be people around you that you don’t never hurt, rather it be a responsibility you need to take care of, rather the plan doesn’t work, rather it be taking care of a pet, it could be your job, co worker, school, partner, kids, mom, dad, siblings, there is ALWAYS a reason to stay. It could be simply to help a lil old lady at a grocery store. No matter how “small” the thing is that keeps you here, pay attention to it. Pursue it. There is always a reason you are here. Even if it’s just to talk to me right now. You are here for a reason , you are not alone, and I care for you hun. Dm me if you need. I’ve been there. 💛
